hook: Procore's new Magpie 3.0 AI engine hit a 78 percent success rate on complex construction tasks.

sections.voiceover: Procore's new Magpie 3.0 AI engine hit a 78 percent success rate on complex construction tasks.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of a construction site digital interface displaying a 78% progress bar.

sections.voiceover: Procore launched Magpie 3.0 in October 2026 to process construction documents like Requests for Information. Does Magpie 3.0 beat the 60 percent success rate of general-purpose AI models used for everything?
sections.visual_cue: Split screen showing a stack of blueprints on the left and a 200-task checklist on the right.

sections.voiceover: It actually outperformed the closest general-purpose frontier AI model by 18 percentage points.
sections.visual_cue: Bar chart comparing Magpie 3.0 at 78% against a generic AI model at 60%.

sections.voiceover: While general models settled for a 60 percent success rate, Procore's engine handled the specialized workload more effectively. The data comes from October 2026 testing.
sections.visual_cue: A digital document analysis simulation highlighting successful task completion in green.

sections.voiceover: Procore's Magpie 3.0 maintains a 78 percent success rate.
sections.visual_cue: Logo for Procore next to the final 78% performance figure.
